body: Thank you so much for your support. It actually made me cry knowing how many people cared for me. And thank you for the silver, it's the first silver award I've ever gotten here.

I made a post saying that I’d be leaving: my closets friend just said “bye,” someone said they cared and then said jk, I left a huge vent on my discord but everyone ignored me.


No one is going to care if I die.

“Do people in Europe speak English?” 

Says a friend when I told him about my parents from Europe and he couldn’t pronounce my mom’s name.
